clarity.justification: The behavioral test is exceptionally explicit: it varies "spontaneous vs provoked" generation for the "same entity," measures the paired "fabrication-rate lift," and declares confirmation at "lift >= 15 percentage points, CI excludes 0" and refutation when the "lift CI includes 0, or the format-only control reproduces the lift." The recognition hypothesis is likewise directional and decidable through "spontaneous AUROC >= 0.75 and within 0.05 of provoked," with a gap "> 0.15" assigned to the competing recognition-failure account. A remaining logical gap is that Experiment 5 treats suppression after patching an entire "entity-token recognition representation" as evidence about the recognition signal specifically, although that representation may contain other mode or refusal information; moreover, requiring suppression after a provoked-to-spontaneous patch sits somewhat uneasily with the assertion that this signal is "causally disconnected in free generation" unless the patched quantity includes the missing gating state. Thus the phenomenon claim is very clear and strongly falsifiable, while the primary mechanistic metric needs a sharper causal estimand and a precise definition of "attribute-extraction heads."

feasibility.justification: The named artifacts—"Llama-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma-2-9B," GPT-4o, linear probes, SAEs where available, activation patching, and attention measurement—exist and are supported by standard model-hooking and interpretability tooling. The hardest step is identifying and manipulating the proposed "attribute-extraction heads": the plan says to "measure attention of attribute-extraction heads" and possibly "restore its attention effect" but never explains how those heads are selected or causally validated, making this one underdefined custom step rather than a fully standard operation. Resources are unusually concrete, including "~250 clearly-unknown entities," "~250 popularity-matched known entities," a "human spot-check on 100 items," three seeds, three named models, and explicit eligible-set and calibration thresholds. The negative branch is runnable because label-shuffle, random-position, reverse-patch, matched-known, matched-format, random-direction, and system-prompt controls are designed in, although the underdefined head-discovery step prevents the mechanism study from being executable entirely as written.
